action_id_1: The id that define the place of the action of the enemy
code_1: The codes define the type of action that the enemy did
order_1: The order of the enemy's action based on the 3 actions limit
duration_1: The duration of the enemy's action
ai_buff_id: The active buff that is applied to the ai
ai_debuff_id: The active debuff that is applied to the ai
player_buff_id: The active buff that is applied to the player
player_debuff_id: The active debuff that is applied to the player
ai_hpMax: Max HP of the AI entity
ai_hp: Currently HP of the AI entity
ai_speed: Speed of the AI entity for begin the round
ai_apMax: Max AP for the AI entity in a round
ai_ap: Currently AP of the AI entity
prin_atk: Value of the ATK statistic for the AI
prin_def: Value of the DEF statistic for the AI
neutral_atk: Value of the NEUTRAL ATK statistic for the AI
neutral_def: Value of the NEUTRAL DEF statistic for the AI
lower_atk: Value of the LOWER ATK statistic for the AI
lower_def: Value of the LOWER DEF statistic for the AI
skill_id_1: The id that define the place of the action of the enemy
code_8: The codes define the type of action that the enemy did
duration_8: The duration of the enemy's action
skill_id_3: The id for the skill/spell of the AI
code_10: The code for this skill/spell of the AI
duration_10: Duration of the effect of this AI skill/spell

id_11: The id of the action that the ai choose to do (can be 0 meaning skip)
order_11: Represent the order of the action based on the 3 max actions rule
